patch.value: Make assurance risk help include the required recurrence policy

Observed during recovery delivery: pm assurance risk --help advertises a definition containing only change.files. Executing that exact example returns invalid_argument_value with defect recurrence policy must be an object. Supplying the existing config/defect-recurrence-policy.json as definition.policy succeeds and selects18 relevant recurrence families for the current patch. Fix discovery and prerequisite recovery without fabricating policy or weakening recurrence gates.

Help and contracts disclose policy plus change input; advertised example executes on an isolated nonempty tracker; missing policy returns precise executable recovery; original runtime and token ceilings are preserved
Make the documented risk command executable using only its declared help
Self-improvement risk selection can run without inspecting source for omitted prerequisites
The current help example reproducibly refuses because definition.policy is absent
A copyable risk example supplies or locates a valid policy, and a missing policy names its recovery before any mutation
